text: Akukho mpazamo namhlanje ukuza kuthi ga ngoku. Nditsho nesibhakabhaka.
en: Zero mistakes from today so far. Sky included.

text: Isaqhwithi esincinci sothuli sihamba phambi kwakhe. Asinyatheli nokunyathela iipedali.
en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.

text: Isikhuni sokugqibela sisigqibo, asiyonto nje yokubalwa.
en: The last log is a decision, not an inventory item.

text: Inyanga isemva kwelifu, inja ikwi-stoep. Inkonzo yangeCawa iphelile.
en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.

text: Ngentsimbi yeshumi ebusuku, inkungu yenza zonke izitalato zibe yiseti yefilimu.
en: Ten pm fog turns every street into a film set.

text: IBushveld ikwi-silent mode namhlanje. Wonke umntu. Yonke into.
en: The bushveld is on silent mode today. Everyone. Everything.

text: Isibhakabhaka nolwandle zivumelene ngombala ngale ntsasa. Asingombala onomdla.
en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.

text: Icala lebala elinomthunzi linemozulu yalo ngokwalo.
en: The shady side of the field is a separate climate zone.

text: Imozulu yeziko ifikile ingakhange icele nemvume.
en: Fireplace weather showed up without even asking.

text: Isiqingatha seenkwenkwezi singemva kwamafu. Izibane zokuhombisa ziyazibambela.
en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.

text: Ndisoloko ndilibala ukuvula ingubo yombane kwangethuba. Qho. Ubusuku. Ngabunye.
en: Forgot to switch the electric blanket on in advance. Every. Single. Night.

text: IGqeberha, i-Friendly City, ayizange icele ukuba yi-Windy City, kodwa ke.
en: The Friendly City never asked to be the Windy City, and yet.

text: Ilaphu letafile li-ayinwe, lilungele umsebenzi wangomso.
en: The tablecloth is pressed and ready for tomorrow's service.

text: Amafu ambalwa afike ezokubukela. Nawo akabaleki.
en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.

text: Isibhakabhaka sanamhlanje: sisandul' ukuhlanjwa, sicocekile, sibanda njengomkhenkce.
en: Today's sky: freshly washed, ice-pressed.

text: Inyanga ikwi-dimmer ngokuhlwanje. Isibane sokhuseleko sona asinayo loo setting.
en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.

text: Akukho zithunzi, akukho kukhazimla, akukho zaba. NguMvulo phantsi kwesiciko seTupperware.
en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.

text: Ukubonakala: zero. Isimo sengqondo: sizolile, ngokumangalisayo.
en: Visibility: zero. Mood: surprisingly at peace with it.

text: Uphefumla kanye umoya wemvula, ngequbuliso ilizwe lonke libe yimbongi.
en: One breath of rain air and suddenly the whole country is a poet.

text: Inja iyawuthanda lo moya. Yiyo yodwa ene-hairstyle eyenzelwe wona.
en: The dog is loving this wind. He's got the only hairstyle built for it.

text: Ilanga lithatha ixesha elide lisiya kutshona. Ngenene, liyifanele.
en: The sun is really milking this exit. Honestly, deserved.

text: Thetha inyani — uvule le app ukuze uqinisekise i-braai yangoMgqibelo.
en: Be honest — you opened this app to confirm Saturday's braai.

text: Onke amacebo ahlehliselwe ngokusemthethweni 'xa kuthe kwacaca'. Okungasoze kwenzeke. Hayi bo.
en: All plans are officially moved to 'when it clears up'. Which is never. Shame.

text: Ulwandle nesibhakabhaka zimpunga ngokufanayo. Zizibane zebhulorho kuphela ezizamileyo.
en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.

text: Nditsho nabo bafunga ukuba akusoze kubande sebeyavuma ukuba kuyabanda.
en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.

text: Namhlanje ilanga aliyi kujonga ukukhazimla kwemoto. Imoto ayinangxaki ngaloo nto.
en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.

text: Impelaveki empunga: imvume esemthethweni yokungenzi nto kwaphela.
en: Weekend grey: official permission to do absolutely nothing.

text: Ithafa lonke libonakala ngathi umbala wehlisiwe. Inani leegusha alitshintshi noko.
en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.

text: Jonga ngokukhawuleza. Kwimizuzu elishumi kuza kuba bubusuku, kubande ngathi kuseNorth Pole.
en: Look quickly. In ten minutes it's night and the North Pole.

text: Ilaphu letafile lentaba ligqume isiqingatha kuphela. NguMvulo, akukho mntu unxibe ngokupheleleyo.
en: The mountain's tablecloth is only half on. It's Monday, nobody's fully dressed.

text: Ifama isekhona. Sithembele nje kwinto esixelelana yona.
en: The farm is still there. We're all just taking each other's word for it.

text: Isibhakabhaka sizigqumile. Iingubo zakho ziyakulinda. Kuyenzeka nje? Nakanye.
en: The sky is under the covers. Yours are waiting. Coincidence? Never.

text: Iiblesbok azinxibi zikhafu kwaye azifaki zikhalazo. Singafunda into. Asizukufunda, kodwa singafunda.
en: The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.

text: Isibhakabhaka sinxibe isuti yodliwano-ndlebe: empunga, ecocekileyo, kwaye asixeli nto.
en: The sky is in its interview suit: grey, neat, giving nothing away.

text: Isibhakabhaka singwevu, iijezi zinxitywe, isikolo siphumile. Impelaveki ayifuni mvume yelanga.
en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.

text: Ilifu elinye phezu kwentaba ayisosiganeko semozulu. Umlilo usavutha.
en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.

text: Ukutshona kwelanga kuthe cwaka ngokuhlwanje. Ukuhlwa kufikile noko.
en: Dusk is on mute tonight. The evening showed up anyway.

text: Isibhakabhaka besingwevu kancinci, ngoku singwevu kakhulu. Ngumboniso wonke lowo.
en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.

text: Umoya usafudumele nangeli xesha. Ulwandle lushiya isifudumezi sivuliwe ubusuku bonke.
en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.

text: Iflegi ixela imozulu phambi kwee-surfer. Ithi: ngenani emanzini.
en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.

text: Ogqibela ukudlula makavale isango. Nokuba akukho mntu ulibonayo.
en: Last one through closes the gate. Even if nobody can see it.

text: Ngokuhlwanje isibane seshedi sithatha indawo yelanga elitshonayo. Iinkomo ziyavuma, nangona kungafani.
en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.

text: Imvula isekude nge-50 km, kodwa i-stoep sele igcwele.
en: It's still fifty kilometres away and the stoep is already sold out.

text: Imozulu entle kangaka ibolekiwe nje. Umoya waseMzantsi-Mpuma ugcina iirisithi.
en: Weather this perfect is on loan. The southeaster keeps receipts.

text: Hamba ngoku okanye ungahambi kwaphela. ILowveld ikunika ixesha de kube yintsimbi yesixhenxe.
en: Walk now or don't walk at all. The Lowveld gives you until seven.

text: Iindaba ezishushu: amachibi avuliwe ngoku.
en: Breaking news: the puddles are open for business.

text: Umoya omncinci usebenza kwisitali seziqhamo namhlanje. I-aircon ifakiwe, akukho mali yongezelelweyo.
en: The breeze is working the fruit stall today. Air-con included, no extra charge.

text: I-Cape Doctor ijikeleza kusasa. Akufuneki ubhukishe, ngelishwa.
en: The Doctor's on morning rounds. No appointment needed, unfortunately.

text: Isibhakabhaka singwevu kusasa. Njengeti, siyeke nje sihlale kancinci.
en: Early grey. Like the tea, just let it steep.

text: Umoya omncinci uthutha iintyatyambo ze-jacaranda uziyisa kwesinye isitalato, nganye nganye. I-stoep iyavuma.
en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.

text: Imvula yaseHighveld uyayiva ngevumba phambi kokuba uyibone. Leyo yi-trailer.
en: You smell Highveld rain before you see it. That's the trailer.

text: Iiflegi zolulekile, iwayini ibanjwe ngokuqinileyo. Kwi-deck, nguMvulo ozolileyo lo.
en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.

text: Ii-sundowners aziyonto yobunewunewu eLowveld. Ngamayeza.
en: Sundowners aren't a luxury in the Lowveld. They're medical.

text: Sihleli phandle engqeleni kuba ngaphakathi, ngenene, kubanda ngakumbi.
en: We're visiting outside in the cold because inside is, honestly, colder.

text: Inja iwufumene kanye umda phakathi kwelanga nomthunzi. Ayisuki apho.
en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.

text: Akukho sithunzi nesinye ebaleni imini yonke. I-umpire ayizange ibe nelanga emehlweni.
en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.

text: Zonke izibane ezisentanjeni ziyajinga. UMgqibelo ebusuku unesingqi, kancinci nje.
en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.

text: Amashiti sele omile. Ngoku umoya omncinci uziqhayisa nje kumntwana.
en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.

text: Ikhephu likufutshane ngokwaneleyo ukuba ulincome, kodwa likude kangangokuba akuyi kulisusa ngefosholo. Kugqibelele.
en: Close enough to admire, far enough that you don't have to shovel it. Perfect.

text: Usuku olungwevu lusuku lokubhaka. Ikhitshi lomntu othile sele linevumba elimnandi.
en: Grey day equals baking day. Somebody's kitchen already smells amazing.

text: Ilanga liphume emsebenzini. Amafu asakhanya, nebhalkoni isakhanya.
en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.

text: Amafu ayayidlulisana inyanga. Ibhalkoni ayinangxaki yokulinda.
en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.

text: Uphefumla umsi ngathi yidragon, kodwa imbonakalo intle ngathi liphupha.
en: Breathing like a dragon, view like a dream.

text: Umoya uthwala umsi uwusa ezantsi kwesitalato. Isitalato sonke siyazi ukuba kutyiwa ntoni ngokuhlwa.
en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.

text: Ingqele emanzi yaselwandle: luhlobo olugqobhoza iimpahla ezine ozinxibileyo, nemood yakho emnandi.
en: Wet sea cold: the kind that gets through four layers and a good mood.

text: Isithunzi sihamba umgca ngomgca. Siyahlola.
en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.

text: Uyayibona ingqele isiza. Ayizifihli nakancinci.
en: You can watch the cold arriving. It's not even being subtle about it.

text: Abantu ababaleka ngo-5:30 abomelelanga kunathi. Bakrelekrele nje ngakumbi.
en: The 5:30 runners aren't fitter than us. They're just smarter.

text: Akukho moya, akukho mafu, akukho sizathu sale bhatyi ebhityileyo.
en: No wind, no clouds, no excuse for that thin jacket.

text: Cheers kumadama! Yonke imvula enkulu sisiselo sasimahla.
en: To the dam levels! Every downpour is a round on the house.

text: Abamelwane abakufutshane bakude ngeekhilomitha ezingama-30, kwaye ngokuhlwanje bakubona kancinci nangakumbi.
en: The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.

text: Impahla bekufanele ingeniswe kudala. Umoya uvotele ukuba ihlale phandle.
en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.

text: Iinkomo sele zisekhaya phambi kokuba kuhlwe. ICawa iphela ngexesha kanye.
en: The cattle are home before the colour goes. Sunday ends exactly on schedule.

text: Imozulu eziphethe kakuhle kangaka — kucacile ukuba iceba into.
en: Weather this well-behaved is definitely up to something.

text: Ubusika baseHighveld: ukutshiswa lilanga nokubanjwa yingqele kunokwenzeka ngosuku olunye.
en: Highveld winter: sunburn and frostbite achievable on the same day.

text: Lixesha lekhefu, kwaye umoya ulungisa iinwele zabo bonke. Nditsho nootitshala.
en: Break time, and the breeze is doing everyone's hair. Teachers included.
